# Plan: Fix Accessibility issues on /products/catalog.html - ARIA roles and missing aria-labels

## Summary
Fix accessibility violations on the products catalog page by adding missing aria-label attributes to the Special Offers link and resolving ARIA role hierarchy violations in the sidenav components.

## Bug Description
The /products/catalog.html page has accessibility violations that impact screen reader users:
1. Special Offers link in the Resources section lacks proper aria-label for screen readers
2. ARIA role hierarchy violations where certain elements don't have required parent/child role relationships
3. Screen readers cannot properly identify link targets and navigation structure

## Root Cause
The accessibility violations originate from two sources:
1. **Missing aria-label**: The Special Offers link in the sidenav Resources section (`sp-sidenav-item href="/products/special-offers.html"`) lacks the aria-label attribute needed for screen readers
2. **ARIA hierarchy violations**: The sidenav structure using `sp-sidenav` and `sp-sidenav-item` components may have incorrect or missing ARIA role relationships

## Relevant Files
- `web-components/test/sidenav/catalog-sidenav.test.html` - contains the Special Offers link missing aria-label (lines 96-102)
- `web-components/src/sidenav/merch-sidenav-list.js` - sidenav list component that may need ARIA fixes
- `da/blocks/sidenav/sidenav.js` - main sidenav implementation with ARIA role handling

## Step by Step Tasks

### 1. Add aria-label to Special Offers link
- Update the Special Offers `sp-sidenav-item` in catalog-sidenav.test.html to include proper aria-label following Milo pattern
- Add `aria-label="Open the Special Offers page in a new tab"` attribute
- Add `target="_blank"` to open in new tab as per the expected pattern

### 2. Fix ARIA role hierarchy in sidenav components
- Review and fix any missing or incorrect ARIA parent-child role relationships in the sidenav structure
- Ensure `sp-sidenav` elements have proper role attributes
- Verify `sp-sidenav-item` elements are properly nested within required parent roles

### 3. Validate changes
- Run axe accessibility tests to confirm violations are resolved
- Test with screen readers to verify proper announcements
- Ensure no new accessibility issues are introduced

## Acceptance Criteria
- All ARIA role hierarchy violations on `/products/catalog.html` are resolved (rules: `aria-required-children`, `aria-required-parent`)
- Special offers link in Resources section includes `aria-label` following the Milo pattern: `aria-label="Open the Special Offers page in a new tab"`
- No new axe violations introduced on the page
- Screen readers can properly identify and announce the Special Offers link target

## Validation Commands
- `node --check web-components/test/sidenav/catalog-sidenav.test.html.js` for changed JS files
- `axe-core` accessibility validation tests
- Manual screen reader testing for proper announcements
